vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: slogan-maker
Version: 2.2.0

The slogan-maker skill bundle is a legitimate utility for generating and evaluating advertising slogans. The core logic in `scripts/slogan.sh` consists of text-based template generation and simple heuristic scoring using standard bash commands, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection attempts.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions match its slogan-generation purpose, require no credentials or network access, and consist of a self-contained Bash script that prints templates and heuristics.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md description (slogan/tagline generation, translation, testing, collections) matches the included scripts/slogan.sh implementation: all listed commands (create, industry, rhyme, translate, test, collection) are implemented and there are no unexpected external capabilities. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md shows version 1.0.0 while registry metadata lists 2.2.0, and the repo metadata lists no homepage even though the help text references bytesagain.com and hello@bytesagain.com — this is a provenance/versioning note to verify but does not change capability coherence.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the script operate entirely on CLI arguments and produce textual output/templates/scores. The script does not read user files, environment variables, system configuration, or contact external endpoints. There is no scope creep: all actions are within the stated purpose of generating and evaluating slogans.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification — this is instruction-only plus a local Bash script. Nothing is downloaded or installed, and no archives or external package installs are performed. Risk is limited to executing the included script locally.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths, and the script does not read any. No secrets or unrelated service credentials are requested or used.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default invocation settings are used. The skill does not attempt to modify other skills, system configuration, or persist credentials. It requires explicit invocation to run.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent and self-contained: it is a local Bash script that prints slogan templates and heuristic scores and does not require credentials or network access. Before running: (1) verify the provenance (registry owner, the bytesagain.com contact in the help) and the version mismatch (SKILL.md v1.0.0 vs registry v2.2.0) if that matters to you; (2) inspect scripts/slogan.sh yourself — executing any shell script runs code on your machine, so run it in a safe environment or with non‑privileged accounts; (3) if you plan to share sensitive input, remember the tool only prints text locally (no exfiltration found), but avoid sending secrets into slogan prompts. If you need higher assurance, ask the publisher for a signed release or a hosted homepage/source repo.
